title: Inside the Quesst - Fall 2022
description: The X-59 research aircraft is the centerpiece of NASA's Quesst mission. It is designed to fly supersonic without creating a loud sonic boom to people on the ground. In this edition  of "Inside the Quesst" (Fall 2022) see the latest manufacturing updates, learn about recent wind tunnel testing in Japan and access a new supersonic STEM toolkit!
